title: Washington and Kansas City will play the NWSL final
lead: After two exciting semi-finals, Washington Spirit and Kansas City Current will play for the title in the top women's league in the USA.
body: The NWSL is the top women's football league in the USA. After last weekend's semi-finals, we know the 2 teams in the final: Washington Spirit and Kansas City Current.

On Saturday 14 November 2026, Washington played Utah Royals at home, in a sold-out stadium. After only 2 minutes, Cloé Lacasse scored directly from a corner! It was the fastest goal in the history of the NWSL play-offs. Sofia Cantore scored again 6 minutes later, and Washington won 2-1.

On Sunday 15 November, Kansas City played in New York against Gotham FC, the champions. Croix Bethune scored a great free kick for Kansas City. Gotham equalised with an own goal, but Haley Hopkins scored the winner in the 89th minute.

The final is on Saturday 21 November at Audi Field, in Washington. The Spirit have lost the last 2 finals, so they really want to win this time. Kansas City have never won the trophy. Who will be the new champions?

title: Kansas City Current win their first NWSL title!
lead: Kansas City Current have beaten Washington Spirit 2-1 in the final and they are the new champions of the top women's league in the USA.
body: On Saturday 21 November 2026, Kansas City Current played Washington Spirit in the NWSL final. The match was at Audi Field, the Spirit's stadium in Washington, in front of 19,365 fans.

There were no goals in the first half. Then, in the 54th minute, Vanessa DiBernardo took a corner and scored directly! The ball curled over the goalkeeper and went into the net. No player has ever scored a goal like this in an NWSL final before.

In stoppage time, Debinha, who came on as a substitute, received a pass from Temwa Chawinga. She went round the goalkeeper and scored into an empty net: 2-0! Trinity Rodman scored a header for Washington at the very end, but it was too late.

It is the first title for Kansas City, a young club that started in 2020. DiBernardo was named the best player of the final. Their coach, Chris Armas, said that Kansas City is "a winning sports town".

title: Late goal saves Man City against Napoli
lead: Manchester City were losing twice against Napoli in the Champions League, but Rayan Cherki scored a late goal to make it 2-2.
body: On Tuesday 24 November 2026, Manchester City played Napoli at the Etihad Stadium in the Champions League. It was a special night because Kevin De Bruyne played for Napoli. He was a City star for many years, so the home fans sang his name and welcomed him back.

There were no goals in the first half. Then, after 55 minutes, Rasmus Højlund scored for Napoli with a low shot. City reacted quickly, and young midfielder Ayyoub Bouaddi equalised in the 67th minute.

But 9 minutes later, Noa Lang scored a fantastic volley on the counter-attack: 2-1 to Napoli! City attacked again and again. Finally, in the 86th minute, Rayan Cherki scored with a low shot, and it was 2-2.
After 5 matches, City are sixth in the table, so they are in the top 8 for now. But they have played 10 games without a clean sheet, so their coach, Enzo Maresca, has work to do in defence.

title: Isak scores twice as Liverpool win 3-0 in Belgium
lead: Liverpool travelled to Belgium and beat Club Brugge 3-0 in the Champions League, with 2 goals from Alexander Isak.
body: On Wednesday 25 November 2026, Liverpool travelled to Bruges, in Belgium, to play Club Brugge at the Jan Breydel Stadium. There were 27,286 fans in the stadium, and most of them wanted a home win.

But Liverpool started well. After only 13 minutes, the Brugge goalkeeper made a bad pass, and Alexander Isak scored. Brugge attacked a lot after that, but Liverpool's goalkeeper, Alisson, made some important saves.

Then, in the 79th minute, Florian Wirtz scored a beautiful curling shot from far away: 2-0! 3 minutes later, Isak got his second goal when he chipped the ball over the goalkeeper. After the match, he said it was "a perfect away win".

Liverpool have now won 4 of their 5 matches, so they are fifth in the table with 12 points. Their coach, Andoni Iraola, was pleased because his team didn't concede a goal. Their next Champions League match is against Porto at Anfield.
